[/list]

notes.title: Game Update
notes.content:
[b]What's new:[/b]
[list]
[*] HR Dept. added to the game - now Player can upgrade their Stats
[*] Prompt for interaction is added to some of the objects witch which the Player can interact
[/list]

[b]What's updated/changed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Player and Enemy Dev. sprites are updates - now they have muscular hands
[*] Changed the lighting in some levels and the light source of the flashlight
[*] Enemies now cast shadows
[*] Changed the visual effect when energy is activated
[*] Portal for next level look different and is activated upon <Interact> button pressed instead of on contact
[*] Added flying NPC-s in the background
[/list]
